subcategory_text: Data analytic inputs and outputs are identified and evaluated for bias.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: RA-3, AC-2(1) (Automated Account Management)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.34 (Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 ID.RA-02 (cyber threat intelligence) and AI RMF MEASURE 2.11 (bias evaluated)
implementation_examples: Identify the inputs and outputs of any analytics (including machine-learning models and rules engines) that process personal data
Evaluate inputs and outputs for bias across demographic dimensions relevant to the data subjects
Document the bias evaluation, its results, and the mitigations applied as part of the privacy-risk record
assessment_objectives: Determine whether analytic inputs and outputs are identified
Determine whether bias evaluation covers demographic dimensions relevant to data subjects
Determine whether bias results are recorded and used to inform risk prioritisation
Determine whether mitigations are documented for identified bias
